name: Beef Porcupines
description: Baked meatballs with rice, served in a tangy tomato-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix ground beef, rice, onion, mustard, chili powder, salt, allspice, brown sugar, pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and paprika. Form into balls.
Place meatballs in a baking dish.
Combine tomato soup and hot water to make the sauce. Pour over meatballs.
Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.name: Sticky Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish baked in a sticky sauce with pineapple and mushrooms.

recipeInstructions.text: Shake chicken pieces in a bag with flour, paprika, ginger, and garlic powder to coat.
Combine pineapple juice and water to make 1 cup. Add brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, soya sauce, and drained mushrooms. Mix well.
Place the coated chicken in a pan, skin side down. Pour the sauce over the chicken.
Bake at 350°F, uncovered, for 1 hour. Baste often and turn the chicken at 30 minutes.
During the last 5 minutes, add drained pineapple tidbits and an additional can of drained mushrooms.

_similar.keywords: sticky chicken, baked chicken, pineapple chicken

_similar.name: Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: Traditional cabbage rolls filled with a savory mixture of ground pork, beef, and rice, simmered in tomato juice.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the cabbage head for 10 minutes to soften the leaves. Drain and let cool.
Chop the onion and fry in lard for 10 minutes until softened.
Mix the cooked onion and lard with ground pork, ground beef, rice, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Peel off cabbage leaves and cut out the thick stem. Place about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each leaf, fold the sides, and roll into a neat package.
Line the bottom of a large pot with a layer of cabbage leaves to prevent burning.
Arrange the cabbage rolls seam-side down in the pot, layering them as needed.
Pour the tomato juice over the cabbage rolls, ensuring they are mostly covered.
Bring the tomato juice to a simmer, then reduce heat and let cook for the entire afternoon (approximately 3 hours).

_similar.keywords: cabbage rolls, stuffed cabbage, ground meat, comfort food

_similar.name: Cheeseburger Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A cheeseburger-inspired meatloaf with a cheddar cheese and pickle relish filling, topped with tomato sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: In a mixing bowl, combine ground beef, egg, bread crumbs, garlic salt, onion powder, salt, pepper, and seasoning salt. Mix well.
Mix chopped onion and tomato sauce together in a separate bowl.
Add half of the tomato sauce and onion mixture to the beef mixture and mix well.
Pack half of the beef mixture into a loaf pan.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese and sweet pickle relish evenly over the top.
Pack the remaining beef mixture on top and press firmly.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F for 1 hour.
Carefully spoon off excess fat from the top.
Pour the remaining tomato sauce and onion mixture over the meatloaf.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for about 5 minutes before inverting onto a heated serving platter if desired.

_similar.keywords: cheeseburger meatloaf, stuffed meatloaf, cheddar and pickle filling

_similar.name: Chili Con Carne
_similar.description: A hearty and versatile chili recipe featuring ground beef, kidney beans, and a variety of vegetables, ideal for customization.
recipeIngredient: Optional: additional vegetables like zucchini, carrots, mushrooms

recipeInstructions.text: In a large nonstick skillet, cook ground beef over medium-high heat until browned and crumbly; drain off excess fat.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes.
Add cabbage, celery, green pepper, tomatoes with juice, tomato sauce, kidney beans, chili powder, oregano, salt, and hot pepper sauce to the skillet.
Optionally add other desired vegetables (e.g., zucchini, carrots, mushrooms) at this stage.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes, or until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.

_similar.keywords: chili con carne, ground beef chili, customizable chili
